column1: Swisstory, History of Switzerland|2019|10|10||7,5.5,4.5,4.5,7,8,3,6,8,6.5|Laurie Theurer|An illustrated explanatory national history, not fiction or a technical curriculum. Political institutions and Swiss historical episodes dominate, so both T11 and T12 apply. Sivers reports a concise answer to his historical questions; D=7 is a reader-report estimate, not proof from brevity. Broad ancient-to-modern survey has no single central period endpoint. https://books.google.com/books/about/Swisstory.html?id=KkzlyQEACAAJ confirms English edition and 2019. Low domain fit remains included.

Vagabonding|2002|0|10||6.5,3.5,5.5,4,6,7.5,2,7.5,7.5,7|Rolf Potts|Travel philosophy and practical reflection, not specialist technical training. Reframing time, spending and experience provides some reusable ideas, but little systems or domain content. T12 applies to its central philosophy of life. Sivers reports few new insights, supporting D=6 provisionally; no claim that familiar advice is universally empty. https://www.penguinrandomhouseretail.com/book/?isbn=9780812992182 gives first on-sale date December 24, 2002; 2003 copyright does not reset it. No single historical endpoint.

Knowledge, Reality, and Value|2021|0|10||7.5,4.5,7,6,8,9,5,8.5,8,8|Michael Huemer|Accessible sustained philosophical arguments about knowledge, reality and ethics; not specialist formal proof training despite introductory-course applicability. Sivers praises precise definitions and clear examples. Author's relativism sample supports disciplined exposition; D=8 remains low-confidence across the full book. Philosophy incurs T12. https://spot.colorado.edu/~huemer/sample8.pdf and https://books.google.com/books/about/Knowledge_Reality_and_Value.html?hl=en&id=74trzgEACAAJ&output=html_text . Original 2021. No historical endpoint.

A Gift to My Children|2009|0|10||6,4,5.5,4,6.5,7,3.5,8,7,6.5|Jim Rogers|Investing and life advice from a practitioner's experience; general reflections rather than technical financial training. Transferable curiosity and independent-judgment heuristics prevent a no-payload veto, but anecdotal support and narrow learning yield limit E/M/D. D=6.5 is based on Sivers's brief reading report and publisher description, not the short length alone. https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/156698/a-gift-to-my-children-by-jim-rogers/ verifies 2009, correcting cached 2008. Central investing advice incurs T12; no historical endpoint.

Speaking of India|2007|10|0||6.5,5,6.5,5.5,7,6,4,7.5,7,6.5|Craig Storti|Cross-cultural explanation of communication and workplace expectations, not a technical curriculum. Transfer to organizational coordination is useful but national generalizations are context-sensitive and not individual predictions. Sivers identifies concrete distinctions; D=7 estimates useful examples with a narrow scope. T11 applies to single-country cultural focus; no distinct historical period. Author spelling corrected from source Sorti. https://books.google.com/books/about/Speaking_of_India.html?id=uAoJTwEACAAJ and https://books.google.com/books/about/Speaking_of_India_Bridging_the_Communica.html?id=vP88zQEACAAJ confirm identity and 2007.

UAE Culture Shock|1996|10|0||6.5,4.5,4.5,4,6.5,5,3,6.5,7,6.5|Gina Crocetti Benesh|General cultural explanation and travel advice, not a specialist technical reference. Some transferable awareness of institutional and social norms, but low systems depth and narrow geographical scope. D=6.5 follows Sivers's limited reader report and contents; practical local information dates quickly, reducing R. https://books.google.com/books/about/Culture_Shock_United_Arab_Emirates.html?hl=en&id=QUrnIElbKvoC&output=html_text documents 1996 under the author's earlier name Gina L. Crocetti. Publication year confidence moderate; no historical endpoint.

UAE Culture Smart|2008|10|0||6.5,4.5,4.5,4,6.5,5,3,6.5,7,6.5|John Walsh|A concise general account of customs, social structure and historical background. Not a technical curriculum; low topic fit remains scored. Sivers's report supports introductory utility, not high-confidence density. D=6.5 allows useful distinctions with limited depth; current practical details age. https://goldcoast.overdrive.com/library/community-languages/media/456682 documents the earlier edition; https://books.google.com/books?id=jCNeDwAAQBAJ identifies 2018 as revised. Original 2008 assessed with moderate confidence; no single historical endpoint.

Essays One|2019|0|0||8,3,5,4.5,7,8.5,2,9,8,9|Lydia Davis|Literary criticism and reflections on reading, translation and art, rather than a progressive writing-craft curriculum. Attention to language and observation transfers weakly to this profile. Source reader report and publisher contents suggest varied close readings but substantial lower-fit literary detail; D=7 remains low-confidence. https://us.macmillan.com/books/9780374719241/essaysone/ confirms nonfiction collection and 2019. Original collection date used; pieces span decades without a single central historical period.

The Philosophy of Cognitive-Behavioural Therapy|2010|0|10||7.5,5,6.5,6,7,8,3.5,8,7,7|Donald Robertson|Historical and conceptual explanation of Stoicism's relation to psychotherapy, not primarily a procedural treatment manual. Sivers reports useful reinforcement of ideas; publisher description confirms historical argument. Distinctions between belief, judgment and response supply transferable material, but clinical/philosophical emphasis limits F. D=7 is a low-confidence content-based estimate, not a full-text audit. Philosophy T12 applies; broad ancient-to-modern comparison has no endpoint. https://books.google.com/books/about/The_Philosophy_of_Cognitive_behavioural.html?id=XsOFyJaR5vEC verifies original 2010.
